segments.text: Ok so this is the quickstart page for Vue with OpenAI Agents, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, umm, the page only sets up BuiltInAgent, and says not to use it if you already have an agent.
And it says to use your framework's quickstart for the wiring, but, uh, this is that quickstart.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. The chat does reply, but it's CopilotKit's built-in agent, not an OpenAI Agents agent.
So basically, the page should connect a Vue app to an OpenAI Agents SDK agent, but there's no agent wiring and no Python agent at all.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
